Question: Elmer’s new car gets \(50\%\) better fuel efficiency, measured in kilometers per liter, than his old car. However, his new car uses diesel fuel, which is \(20\%\) more expensive per liter than the gasoline his old car uses. By what percent will Elmer save money if he uses his new car instead of his old car for a long trip?
